verdict.rationale: OpenClaw is an open-source, self-hosted gateway that runs on your own machine. Its memory is stored as plain Markdown files in the local workspace, session history is SQLite-backed per agent, and skills are plain SKILL.md directories, so the data sits in open, locally owned formats you can copy and leave with. The evidence shows no dedicated export or migration feature, so leaving depends on manually taking the workspace and state files. Missing for 10: a documented export/migration command or guide, confirmation that all data (sessions, credentials, channel state, automations) is portable in open formats, and independent or hands-on corroboration of a clean exit.
